OFFICIAL RULES
BRIGHTLEAF COFFEE "SPRING ROAST" SWEEPSTAKES

NO PURCHASE OR PAYMENT OF ANY KIND IS NECESSARY TO ENTER OR WIN. A PURCHASE WILL NOT INCREASE YOUR CHANCES OF WINNING. VOID WHERE PROHIBITED BY LAW.

1. Sponsor.

The sponsor of this Sweepstakes is Brightleaf Coffee Roasters, LLC, 2200 Chestnut Street, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania 19103 (the "Sponsor"). The administrator is Clearwater Promotions, Inc., 55 Pine Street, Suite 300, Providence, Rhode Island 02903 (the "Administrator").

2. Eligibility.

The Sweepstakes is open only to legal residents of the fifty (50) United States and the District of Columbia who are 18 years of age or older at the time of entry. Employees, officers, and directors of the Sponsor, the Administrator, and their respective parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, and advertising and promotion agencies, and the immediate family members and household members of each, are not eligible to enter or win. The Sweepstakes is void in Puerto Rico, all other United States territories, and wherever else prohibited or restricted by law.

3. Sweepstakes Period.

The Sweepstakes begins at 12:00:00 a.m. Eastern Time on April 1, 2026 and ends at 11:59:59 p.m. Eastern Time on May 31, 2026 (the "Sweepstakes Period"). The Administrator's computer is the official timekeeping device for the Sweepstakes.

4. How to Enter.

There are two ways to enter, and each entrant may enter by either method, but is limited to one (1) entry per person per day during the Sweepstakes Period.

(a) Online Entry. Visit brightleafcoffee.com/springroast and complete the entry form with your first and last name, email address, and state of residence, then submit the form.

(b) Mail-In Entry. Hand print your first and last name, complete mailing address, email address, and date of birth on a 3" x 5" card and mail it in a #10 envelope with sufficient first-class postage to: Brightleaf "Spring Roast" Sweepstakes, P.O. Box 7714, Providence, Rhode Island 02940. Mail-in entries must be postmarked by May 31, 2026 and received by June 7, 2026. Mechanically reproduced entries are not eligible.

Entries that are incomplete, illegible, or that do not comply with these Official Rules are void. Entries become the property of the Sponsor and will not be returned. Proof of submission is not proof of receipt.

5. Prizes.

One (1) Grand Prize: a twelve-month coffee subscription (twelve monthly shipments of two 12-ounce bags) plus a home espresso machine. Approximate retail value ("ARV"): $2,400.

Ten (10) First Prizes: a three-month coffee subscription. ARV: $135 each.

Total ARV of all prizes: $3,750. Odds of winning depend on the number of eligible entries received. Prizes are not transferable and no substitution is permitted, except that the Sponsor reserves the right to substitute a prize of equal or greater value if an advertised prize becomes unavailable. All prize details not specified above are at the Sponsor's sole discretion.

6. Winner Selection and Notification.

Winners will be selected in a random drawing from among all eligible entries received during the Sweepstakes Period. The drawing will be conducted on or about June 12, 2026 by the Administrator, whose decisions are final and binding on all matters relating to this Sweepstakes. Winners will be notified by email within three (3) business days after the drawing. If a winner does not respond within five (5) business days after the first notification attempt, if a notification is returned as undeliverable, or if a winner is found to be ineligible, the prize will be forfeited and an alternate winner may be selected from among the remaining eligible entries.

7. Taxes.

All federal, state, and local taxes on a prize are the sole responsibility of the winner. The Grand Prize winner will be required to complete and return an IRS Form W-9 and will be issued an IRS Form 1099 for the ARV of the prize.

8. Affidavit and Release.

Except where prohibited, the Grand Prize winner must sign and return an affidavit of eligibility, a liability release, and, where lawful, a publicity release within ten (10) days after the date of the notification, or the prize will be forfeited and an alternate winner may be selected.

9. Publicity.

Except where prohibited by law, entry constitutes the winner's consent to the Sponsor's use of the winner's name, city and state of residence, photograph, and statements about the Sweepstakes for advertising and promotional purposes, in any medium, worldwide, without further compensation or notice. Residents of Tennessee may decline this use without forfeiting the prize.

10. Release and Limitation of Liability.

By entering, each entrant releases the Sponsor, the Administrator, and their respective parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, agents, and employees from any liability for any loss, injury, or damage arising out of participation in this Sweepstakes or the acceptance, possession, use, or misuse of a prize. The Sponsor is not responsible for lost, late, misdirected, garbled, or incomplete entries, or for technical failures of any kind. Nothing in these Official Rules limits liability for personal injury or death caused by the Sponsor's negligence, or for any liability that cannot be limited by law.

11. Disputes and Governing Law.

These Official Rules are governed by the laws of the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania, without regard to its conflict of laws rules. Any dispute arising out of this Sweepstakes shall be brought exclusively in the state or federal courts located in Philadelphia County, Pennsylvania, and each entrant consents to the jurisdiction of those courts. Each entrant agrees that any claim is limited to actual out-of-pocket expenses incurred in entering, and that in no event will attorneys' fees or punitive damages be awarded.

12. Winners List.

For the names of the winners, send a self-addressed stamped envelope, to be received by August 31, 2026, to: Brightleaf "Spring Roast" Winners List, P.O. Box 7715, Providence, Rhode Island 02940. Residents of Vermont may omit return postage.

13. Privacy.

Information collected from entrants is subject to the Sponsor's Privacy Policy at brightleafcoffee.com/privacy and will be used to administer the Sweepstakes and, where the entrant has opted in, to send marketing email. An entrant may opt out at any time using the link in any marketing email.

14. General.

The Sponsor reserves the right to cancel, suspend, or modify the Sweepstakes if fraud, a technical failure, or any other factor beyond the Sponsor's reasonable control impairs the integrity of the Sweepstakes, and in that event to award the prizes from among the eligible entries received before the impairing event. Any attempt to deliberately damage the website or undermine the operation of the Sweepstakes is a violation of criminal and civil law, and the Sponsor reserves the right to seek damages to the fullest extent permitted. If any provision of these Official Rules is held unenforceable, the remaining provisions remain in effect.
